'''Saban 7 (February 22)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Mat]] agrees to help three [[Aes Sedai]] escape [[Ebou Dar]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Bethamin Zeami]] is ordered by a [[Seekers for Truth]] to spy on [[Egeanin Tamarath|Egeanin]] and informs Egeanin of it.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] kills [[Manel Rochaid|Rochaid]]. [[Raefar Kisman|Kisman]] escapes, only to be killed by [[Padan Fain]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Slayer]] murders a couple who moved the room where Rand had been staying [[Far Madding]].
*[[1000 NE]] - A number of [[Two Rivers]] girls arrive at the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] camp.
*[[1000 NE]] - The [[gholam]] arrives in Ebou Dar and begins to kill.
